sentences.text:
(By Sri.Mahesh Shetty, Hcgp For R.1;
Sri.Mahesh Y.L., Advocate For R.2)

This Criminal Petition Is Filed U/Sec.439 Cr.P.C By The
Advocate For The Petitioner Praying That This Honble
Court May Be Pleased To Enlarge The Petitioner On Bail
In Cr.No.67/2022 Of Devanahalli P.S., Bengaluru City For
The Offence P/U/S.376(2)(i) Of Ipc And SEC.5(j)(ii) And 6 Of
Pocso Act Pending On The File Of Additional District
And Sessions Judge, Ftsc-Ii Bengaluru Rural District At
Bengaluru And Etc.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo dated 13.03.2023 for withdrawal of the petition with a liberty to file a fresh petition before the Trial Court.
2. The memo is placed on record.
3. In view of the above said memo, this criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn with a liberty as prayed for.

Sd/-
